Limble CMMS

Modern, easy-to-use CMMS software built by maintenance professionals.

Founded 2015
Pricing Model Subscription
Deployment Cloud / SaaS

Overview

Limble CMMS is designed to be highly intuitive and easy to deploy. It focuses on reducing equipment downtime and organizing maintenance operations through a streamlined mobile and web interface. Limble is known for its excellent customer support and rapid feature development based on user feedback.


Visit Official Website

Key Features

  • Mobile Maintenance App
  • Preventive Maintenance
  • Work Requests Portal
  • Enterprise Asset Management
  • Parts and Inventory Management
  • Custom Dashboards and Reporting

Target Industries

  • Manufacturing
  • Facilities
  • Gyms
  • Schools

Pros

  • Exceptional user interface and experience
  • Outstanding customer support
